name: Elven Lords
description: Rulers who enslaved mankind until overthrown.

description_citations.text: "Vantress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords from the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and founds five knightly courts around the Circle of Loyalty.
timeline.quote: mankind took a stand on the mesa that would become Castle Ardenvale and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Garenbrig is established around the Great Henge.
timeline.quote: The court of Garenbrig was established around the Great Henge .

citation.text: "Garenbrig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eight or nine generations before the Wildered Quest, mankind overthrows the Elven Lords, the five knightly courts are created, and Vantress is established around Indrelon.
timeline.quote: The court of Vantress was established around Indrelon .

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
